videos.script:
Today the template goes, and the planner's first screen takes its place. {{clean}} Three files come first, and none of them is React. The shape of the data, the data, and the arithmetic of weeks.

{{jsx}} Then the first component. It looks like HTML inside JavaScript. It is neither. Every tag becomes a function call before the browser sees it, and that one fact explains every rule JSX has.

{{components}} A component is a function with a capital letter. Get the capital wrong, and React tells you so on the console, while the page quietly drops what you meant.

{{props}} Props are how a parent hands data to a child. They flow one way, down the tree. And they are read-only. You will break that rule on purpose, and watch every course name on the screen change.

{{children}} Then a frame that wraps whatever it is given. That is how React shares a layout, without inheritance.

{{types}} And last, the type checker. Vite does not run it, so a wrong prop can still draw a page. You will see where it is caught.
